items.title: Free Crossing Palm Fronds DXF Panel for CNC Gates
items.description: Two large diagonal palm fronds cross through the panel, their feathered leaflets branching off in a natural, wind-swept arrangement. The bold diagonal composition and generous negative space give this tropical-themed design a breezy, resort-style character distinct from the denser botanical patterns in this collection.

items.title: Quatrefoil Border Climbing Vine DXF Panel for CNC Doors
items.description: A dense quatrefoil lattice border frames a single climbing floral vine with small blossoms and leaves winding up the panel's center. The strong geometric border contrasts with the free-flowing vine, giving this piece a balance between structure and organic growth.
